text.p: These are the leading stories in Botswana's independent weekly newspapers The Guardian and Mmegi (The Reporter) published on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A new political party could soon be registered in Botswana. Leputu Setshwelo, director of the Botswana Productivity Centre, is expected to lead the party. He retires from the centre in July.

- Agriculture Minister Roy Blackbeard, the last white parliamentarian in Botswana, will step down before the ruling party congress in July. He is expected to take up a job with the British subsidiary of the Botswana Meat Commission.
- The government has amended public service regulations that forbid public officers to talk to the press without prior permission of a permanent secretary or minister.

- Money has been earmarked for a national television service, the minister of presidential affairs and public adminisrration told parliament. Broadcasting is expected to start next year with news and current affairs programmes.
